contexts.comment: Rows of LoadControlMenu's pause-or-cancel popup -- a separate context from LoadControl above on purpose: those icons are painted inside the control's own filled circle and are coloured for contrast against it, while these are ordinary drop-down menu rows on the menu background. Colours here mirror the generic DropdownMenu context (and so the per-item chat file menu, which resolves to the same values) rather than the control's.
contexts.name: LoadControlMenu
